question: In the spray-dried natural dye study, what is the ratio of D90 to D50 for Maltodextrin 3?
rendered:
Document: Standardisation of natural dye powders via spray drying: initial physicochemical characterisation

Table 2: Particle size characteristics of the maltodextrin reference
Columns: Sample | Main peak/D50 (nm) | D90 (nm) | PDI
Sample | Main peak/D50 (nm) | D90 (nm) | PDI
Maltodextrin 3 | 18.97 | 48.10 | 0.1739

To find the ratio of D90 to D50 for Maltodextrin 3, divide D90 by D50:
D90 / D50 = 48.10 / 18.97
= 2.54
